trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: Integration of ICT/SMC, Supply and Demand, and Trend Indicators. The H4 and H1 trends are strongly bearish, with price trading below the descending EMA50/200. Price is retracing into a premium M15 supply zone (77400.00 - 77450.00) which acts as a bearish Order Block formed during the 21:00 UTC breakdown.

Confluence 2: Integration of BOS (Break of Structure), MSNR (Malaysian SNR), and Momentum Indicators. The sharp drop to 76967.13 created a clear bearish BOS on the M15 timeframe. The retracement back to 77400.00 retests a broken support level (MSNR) while the M15 RSI remains capped below the 50 level (46.1), confirming bearish momentum dominance.

Confluence 3: Integration of FVG (Fair Value Gap), CRT (Candle Range Theory), and Volatility Indicators. The rapid expansion down left an unmitigated FVG on the M15 timeframe between 77338.00 and 77184.00. As price expands upward to fill this gap, it reaches the upper boundary of the CRT consolidation range. This move of ~115 points from the current price aligns perfectly with the M15 ATR(14) of 115.75, signaling volatility exhaustion at the entry zone.

Confluence 4: Integration of Quarter Theory (QT), Chart Patterns, and Volume Indicators. The 77500.00 major quarter level acts as a psychological barrier. Price is forming a bearish flag/bearish continuation pattern on the lower timeframes (M15/M5) with declining volume on the upward retracement, indicating a lack of buying pressure as it approaches the defensive staff.

Confluence 5: Integration of Fibonacci Retracement, Standard Deviation (SD), and Candlestick Patterns. The entry price of 77415.00 aligns with the 0.707 - 0.786 Fibonacci retracement level (golden pocket) of the recent swing high (77504.01) to swing low (76967.13) move. This zone represents a +2 Standard Deviation extension from the local M5 mean, coinciding with previous long upper wick rejections on the H1 timeframe.

The corrective upward retracement is exhausting into a premium supply zone / bearish order block at 77400.00-77450.00, backed by declining volume and overhead resistance at the 77500.00 major quarter level.

risk_profile.note: Preemptive entry captures full HTF continuation without waiting for wick confirmation.
